rules.statement: Parties who are in dispute as to whether a land must be conveyed by one to the other have a dispute in respect of immovable property within the meaning of section 6 (a) of the Conciliation Boards Act even though in law the determination of the dispute may depend upon the terms of a contract.
rules.supporting_quote: "Parties who are in dispute as to whether a land must be conveyed by one to the other do have a dispute in respect of that land even though in law the determination of the dispute may depend upon the terms of a contract."
